coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1 (computed from smoothed stochastic bound formula, sinc factor included where relevant)
notes: POLARBEAR 150 GHz observations of Crab Nebula (Tau A) polarization angle oscillation searching for ultralight ALP dark matter. Primary result is stochastic 95% upper bound: g_agamma <= 2.16e-12 GeV^-1 * (ma/1e-21 eV) * sinc(ma/3.7e-19 eV)^-1, valid over mass range 9.9e-23 to 7.7e-19 eV. Data points computed from this smoothed formula; bound is linear in mass with a sinc resonance null at 3.7e-19 eV (bound diverges there). A deterministic bound (1.0e-12 GeV^-1 * ma/1e-21) is also given but stochastic is the stated primary result. Values above ~2e-19 eV omitted due to sinc pole near 3.7e-19 eV.
